integrity: Analytical graph Laplacian inverse and Sylvester-inertia proof, exact symbolic polynomial identities and rational spectral examples; no claim of experimental prediction, universal graph ranking, or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed total undirected migration conductance, equal edge weights within each graph, one favorable patch, three identical drought sinks, linearized invasion and a local-logistic deterministic extension. No demographic noise, spatial geometry or empirical calibration.
title: A sharp four-patch corridor-budget inversion at \(B=\sqrt{3}\,d\)
